# emb SDK CI probe flatpak

Packages emb SDK CI probe as a flatpak (`io.github.jwinarske.EmbSdkCiProbe`) with
[emb](https://github.com/toyota-connected/emb_cli). `emb-sdk-ci-probe.emb.yaml` names the
embedder, the app, the Flutter SDK and the flatpak runtime, so a build needs nothing
but this directory.

## Build

`flatpak` and `flatpak-builder` must be installed, with the runtime the
manifest names:

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists --user flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
flatpak install --user -y flathub org.freedesktop.Platform//26.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk//26.08
```

Then:

```sh
emb cross emb-sdk-ci-probe.emb.yaml --target local --build --flatpak
```

The first build clones the embedder and the app and installs the Flutter SDK into
`workspace/`; later builds reuse them. The bundle is written to
`workspace/.config/flutter_workspace/cross-build-*/dist/`.

## Install and run

```sh
flatpak install --user workspace/.config/flutter_workspace/cross-build-*/dist/io.github.jwinarske.EmbSdkCiProbe_stable_*.flatpak
flatpak run io.github.jwinarske.EmbSdkCiProbe
```

## Build against the flatpak SDK

`sdk-x86_64` build against `org.freedesktop.Sdk` for that architecture
instead of this machine's libraries. A native build on a host newer than the
runtime can produce a flatpak that will not start, because it needs a newer
glibc than the runtime has; these targets cannot. They also need none of the
embedder's `-dev` packages here.

This machine compiles with its own clang, so it needs `clang`, `lld` and
`llvm` (the package names on Fedora and Ubuntu), plus the SDK and runtime for
each architecture:

```sh
flatpak install --user -y flathub org.freedesktop.Platform/x86_64/26.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk/x86_64/26.08
```

Then:

```sh
emb cross emb-sdk-ci-probe.emb.yaml --target sdk-x86_64 --build --flatpak
```

The CI workflow builds `--target sdk-x86_64`.

## Before publishing

- `icon.png` is a placeholder. Replace it with a 256×256 PNG of your own.
- `metainfo.xml` has no license. `project_license` is a `TODO` on purpose: a
  wrong license is worse than a missing one, and flathub will not accept the
  placeholder.
- `rev:` values in `emb-sdk-ci-probe.emb.yaml` are the commits that were current when
  this repo was generated. Update them deliberately; the comment beside each
  names the branch it came from.
